request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
What do I have to pay in the next four weeks?

response.text:
Four weeks from today runs to about 26 Oct. These payments are due in that time:

- TechMarkt Online reminder total, due Wed 30 Sep 2026: 94.99 € [item:itm_bfvgt8ybg96k]. Send it by Tue 29 Sep 2026. If it stays unpaid, the claim may go to a debt collection company.
- Parking warning fine (Stadt Musterstadt, Ordnungsamt), due Fri 2 Oct 2026: "30.00 €" [item:itm_31yxpwg03cdb]. Ordnung could not verify this amount, so check it against the paper letter. If you agree with the warning, you pay it. Otherwise a fine proceeding may start, with extra costs.
- Service charge back-payment (Wohnbau Musterstadt eG), due Fri 9 Oct 2026: 184.30 € [item:itm_d6mp7bnzdzjw]. Use the reference MV-2025-0412 NK 2025.
- Extension fee at the Ausländerbehörde appointment, due Wed 14 Oct 2026 at 10:30: 100.00 € [item:itm_wj2v05avgk1m]. Pay on site by girocard, because cash is not accepted.
- Health and care insurance contribution (Muster BKK), due Thu 15 Oct 2026: 156.55 € [item:itm_00sbt9f3e0pe]. This is collected by direct debit, so make sure your account has enough funds.
- Electricity advance payment (Stadtwerke), due Thu 15 Oct 2026: 48.00 € [item:itm_kttk9625293w]. This is also a direct debit.

**Ordnung has no due date stored for these:**
- Monthly rent: 640.00 € [item:itm_b1b5643x7qy7]. The letter says it should be received by the third working day of each month.
- Rental deposit (Kaution): 1,560.00 € [item:itm_61wt30mrhybv]. It can optionally be paid in three equal instalments.
- Library overdue fees: 4.50 € [item:itm_kgsfgwac9wzx]. You pay these when you return the items.
- Gym membership fee (FitWell): 29.90 € [item:itm_chhc59r0d16v]. This is collected by direct debit on the 1st of each month.

**Do not pay yet:** a demand for 254.35 € from "Rundfunk-Beitragsservice Zahlungszentrale" [item:itm_zzenc1ydsw7g]. Its letter shows scam signs. These include hidden text, an instruction not to contact the known Beitragsservice, and a different bank account from the one used before. Check with the official Beitragsservice, using contact details you already have, before paying. A genuine sender whose bank details changed would show the same signs.

You can mark payments as done in Ordnung once you have paid them.
